object.attr: derived: CF-V6 (D-V5), review Q75. A lock that a crashed git program left never clears, so committing or discarding again never works until the user deletes the file. In a linked worktree the lock is in the repository's git folder, not under <root>/.git (hand-off from STORE, CF-S4). The review's shall over the analysis's should: the user can't find the file otherwise.
object.description: When Mellon reports that another program holds git's index lock, Mellon shall name the lock file.
